_evidence: 0x51b5a5 (called only from 0x51c659, which stores the object id word +0x12 of each object record in [0x9679a4] and calls it only when 'mov ax,[eax*2+0x9e1b20]; cmp ax,-1; je' finds an entry): 'movzx ebx,word [0x9679a4]; movzx ebx,word [ebx*2+0x9e1b20]; add ebx,0x6975ec'. 0x9e1b20 is the 0x700-word object-id table (reset to 0xffff = absent by 0x51bfda, filled by the loader 0x51c058 with the byte offset of a 0x20-byte entry in the arena 0x6975ec), so [0x9679a4] is an id 0..0x6ff and its table word is an entry offset (never 0xffff here: this routine has no such test, its caller filters it). All 0x700 words draw the offsets 0/0x20/0x40 of the three entries laid out here. Per entry (0x6975ec + k*0x20): u16 +0x14 the flag word tested for 0x1000 (skip), 4 (0x51b644, an empty ret), 0x40 (skip), 8 / 1 (byte [0x7c4ad1]/[0x7c4ad2] = 2, restored by the 'push/pop dword [0x7c4ad1]' pair) and 0x80 (row loop vs. four-pass loop): values reach every outcome of every test, including all bits set/clear. 0x80 path: 'mov eax,[ebx]' u32 any (pushed, '+0x100' per row: its flags are the routine's final flags), 'movzx ecx,word [ebx+6]' the row count of 'loop' (0 would run 2^32 times - a loaded texture has at least one row): 1..0x400; 'movzx edx,word [ebx+4]' any. Four-pass path: 'movzx edx,word [ebx+0x10]' and 'add eax,[ebx+0xc]' any. 0x51b5a4 is an empty ret, so no other memory is read.
